reserveReview.rationale: 2026-07-31 re-open. Issuer docs still list per-network eligible reserve classes (Ethereum: USDC, USDT, USDS, sUSDS, frxUSD, sfrxUSD, Curve LP receipts; Fraxtal: bridged USDC/USDT/DAI/sDAI plus frxUSD/sfrxUSD and Curve LP; Katana: vbUSDC, vbUSDT, AUSD, frxUSD, sfrxUSD; no public Sonic/Ronin eligible-asset tables on the same page). Fresh public-RPC reads at Ethereum block 25648892, Fraxtal block 39321334, and Katana block 38710567 called listCollateral() and totalValue() on the documented collateral vaults, confirming current supported-asset membership and nonzero vault accounting, but they do not yield a publishable multi-deployment weight table: Ethereum remains dominated by AMO-dUSD accounting receipts rather than itemized Curve LP legs; Fraxtal mixes residual sfrxUSD with AMO accounting; Katana exposes multiple idle stablecoin/yieldcoin balances. Sonic/Ronin remain outside the documented reserve table. Protocol accounting totals do not replace a reconciled, weighted reserve balance sheet. Static component percentages remain unsupported; one complete aggregate basket with known-unknown residual is retained. R13 re-open 2026-08-08: the dTRINITY docs and website still publish no reserve percentage breakdown, attestation, or dated balance sheet; no newer composition source was found.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: dTRINITY documented eligible-asset envelope plus 2026-07-31 on-chain listCollateral()/totalValue() reads at Ethereum block 25648892, Fraxtal block 39321334, and Katana block 38710567; current multi-chain asset weights remain undisclosed/unreconcilable
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Per-asset and per-network reserve weights, Curve AMO LP leg valuation, and a cross-deployment assets-and-liabilities reconciliation are not published; on-chain idle vault balances alone are incomplete where AMO debt receipts dominate.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Reserves sit in on-chain CollateralHolderVault / AMO contracts with COLLATERAL_WITHDRAWER_ROLE and strategy roles; docs state chain-isolated reserves. Binding Terms (effective 2026-06-24) disclaim fiduciary, custodian, trustee, and recovery obligations and deny token-holder beneficial interest in protocol assets. No named off-chain bank custodian, legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, alternate-provider continuity plan, or non-rehypothecation covenant for reserve assets was established.
